name: Nemotron-3.5-Embed (1B, 8B)

lineage.how_derived: 8B: language tower initialised from Nemotron-3-Embed-8B and kept frozen, vision encoder and projector trained on top; 1B: distilled from the 8B teacher with cosine plus MSE loss

purpose: Multimodal and multilingual question-answering retrieval: embeds a document page as image, text or both (tables, charts, infographics) so a text query can retrieve pages without OCR; target is vision-RAG and agentic retrieval pipelines (card).

license.name: OpenMDW-1.1
license.notes: LICENSE text read (the rerank repo carries it; the embed repos link the same OpenMDW-1.1): 'permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to deal in the Model Materials without restriction'; redistribution needs the agreement text and notices; rights end if you sue over patent or copyright infringement by the materials; no restriction on outputs. The Ministral-3 base models are Apache-2.0. Card tag 'other' with license_name openmdw-1.1 agrees.

architecture.kind: Pixtral vision encoder plus bidirectional Ministral-3 text tower, mean pooling, L2-normalised
architecture.why_this_design: Reuses the text retrieval strength of Nemotron-3-Embed for pages shown as images; the 1B is distilled from the 8B so small deployments keep most of the quality. Sizes 1.55B (2048-d) and 8.38B (4096-d), dynamic embedding size supported (card).

variants.notes: NVFP4 is a Blackwell format; not usable on RDNA4

pc-16gb.notes: 1B BF16; 8B BF16 16.75 GB does not fit, needs quantization

engine_support.notes: Pixtral vision encoder plus Ministral-3 text tower; no GGUF or llama.cpp support seen on the card (card documents vLLM 0.32 and transformers 5.20 only).

weaknesses: no text-only code retrieval number on the card
no GGUF; vLLM and transformers only
best_for: searching PDFs, slides and screenshots by text query
soft.maturity: NVIDIA, Nemotron retriever line (Nemotron-3-Embed predecessor); released 2026-10-07; downloads 27.8k (1B) and 13.2k (8B) on 2026-11-19 per the HF API. No independent evaluation or user report found.

tona_fit.reason: Permissive license and the strongest documented visual-document retriever here; the 1B fits any class. It serves document pages, not code, so it complements Qwen3-Embedding rather than replacing it.

sources.note: license page read through a summarizer
